report.summary: The router does not validate provider capabilities against task requirements; it relies solely on sensitivity, risk, and review-only flags. A task may be sent to an incapable provider (e.g., Ollama for complex reasoning), producing a silent bad result rather than an explicit error.
risks: No per-task provider capability check; mismatch can yield incorrect output without explicit failure
Trusted-only roles may still reach incapable local bench if external_ok is false and Ollama is available but unsuitable
todos: Add task requirements vs. provider capabilities check before dispatching
Consider fallback to Claude if chosen provider lacks necessary capabilities

handoff.suggestion: Introduce a capabilities map per provider and validate against task complexity or required features; escalate to Claude on mismatch.
